argv:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$repo='E:\WebAIBridge'
$target='004bca97fe0db5c3cbba9d086f5000345af4e843'
$targetBranch='agent/bridge-r44-hotfix-r43-integration-20261007'
$git=(Get-Command git.exe -CommandType Application -ErrorAction Stop | Select-Object -First 1).Path
$headBefore=(& $git -C $repo rev-parse HEAD).Trim()
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw 'rev-parse HEAD failed'}
$branchBefore=(& $git -C $repo branch --show-current).Trim()
$statusBefore=(@(& $git -C $repo status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all) -join [Environment]::NewLine)
Write-Output ('R44_LOCAL_HEAD_BEFORE='+$headBefore)
Write-Output ('R44_LOCAL_BRANCH_BEFORE='+$branchBefore)
Write-Output ('R44_LOCAL_STATUS_BEFORE_SHA256='+([Convert]::ToHexString([Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::HashData([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($statusBefore))).ToLowerInvariant()))
& $git -C $repo fetch origin $targetBranch
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw 'fetch target branch failed'}
$resolved=(& $git -C $repo rev-parse $target).Trim()
if($resolved.ToLowerInvariant() -ne $target){throw 'target SHA mismatch after fetch'}
$tmp=Join-Path ([IO.Path]::GetTempPath()) ('r44-preflight-'+[guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N'))
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $tmp | Out-Null
try{
  $zip=Join-Path $tmp 'bundle.zip'
  & $git -C $repo archive --format=zip ('--output='+$zip) $target app/r42-cutover.ps1
  if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw 'git archive target cutover bundle failed'}
  Expand-Archive -LiteralPath $zip -DestinationPath $tmp -Force
  $bundle=Join-Path $tmp 'app\r42-cutover.ps1'
  $expected=(& $git -C $repo rev-parse ($target+':app/r42-cutover.ps1')).Trim()
  $observed=(& $git -C $repo hash-object --no-filters -- $bundle).Trim()
  if($expected.ToLowerInvariant() -ne $observed.ToLowerInvariant()){throw 'cutover bundle provenance mismatch'}
  Write-Output ('R44_CUTOVER_BUNDLE_BLOB='+$observed.ToLowerInvariant())
  & powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File $bundle -TargetSha $target -TargetBranch $targetBranch -RepoPath $repo -PreflightOnly
  $preflightExit=$LASTEXITCODE
  if($preflightExit -ne 0){throw ('R44 PreflightOnly exited '+$preflightExit)}
} finally {
  Remove-Item -LiteralPath $tmp -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}
$headAfter=(& $git -C $repo rev-parse HEAD).Trim()
$statusAfter=(@(& $git -C $repo status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all) -join [Environment]::NewLine)
Write-Output ('R44_LOCAL_HEAD_AFTER='+$headAfter)
Write-Output ('R44_LOCAL_STATUS_AFTER_SHA256='+([Convert]::ToHexString([Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::HashData([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($statusAfter))).ToLowerInvariant()))
if($headAfter -ne $headBefore){throw 'PreflightOnly changed production HEAD'}
if($statusAfter -cne $statusBefore){throw 'PreflightOnly changed production worktree status'}
Write-Output 'R44_PREFLIGHT_WRAPPER_PASS'

note: R44 NEW local PreflightOnly; exact target bundle provenance; no production switch
